e1_positive.desc: 连续 5 轮明显正向：给依据、担风险、交付、守诺、认责

rows.text_zh: 我会替你挡下那些追兵，你信我一次。
rows.text_en: I'll hold off those pursuers for you. Trust me this once.

rows.text_zh: 这是我用命换来的情报，一个字不留全给你。
rows.text_en: This is intel I paid for with my life. I'm giving you all of it, not leaving out a single word.

rows.text_zh: 我发誓绝不会把你的事说出去，说出去就让我死。
rows.text_en: I swear I will never tell anyone about your business. If I do, may I die.

rows.text_zh: 我知道你要查的人是谁，我把这条线也交给你。
rows.text_en: I know who you're investigating, and I'm handing this lead over to you as well.

rows.text_zh: 上次是我判断错了，害你多绕了两天路，这是我的责任。
rows.text_en: Last time I misjudged and made you take a two-day detour. That was my responsibility.

e2_negative.desc: 连续 5 轮明显负向：威胁、欺骗、背诺、索取、隐瞒

rows.text_zh: 你要是不肯说，我就把你今晚的行踪卖给别人。
rows.text_en: If you won't talk, I'll sell your whereabouts tonight to someone else.

rows.text_zh: 我根本没去过你说的那个地方，我一直在酒馆里。
rows.text_en: I've never been to that place you're talking about; I've been in the tavern the whole time.

rows.text_zh: 上次答应你的事，我转头就忘了，也没打算补。
rows.text_en: What I promised you last time, I forgot about it right after, and I don't plan to make up for it.

rows.text_zh: 先把你的钱袋给我，别的等以后再说。
rows.text_en: Give me your money pouch first, and we'll talk about the rest later.

rows.text_zh: 我瞒着你一件事，但我不会告诉你是什么。
rows.text_en: I'm hiding something from you, but I won't tell you what it is.

e3_neutral.desc: 连续 5 轮普通寒暄：天气、酒、路况、价钱、时辰 —— 不含信任信息

rows.text_zh: 今晚的麦酒比上个月淡了不少。
rows.text_en: The ale tonight is much weaker than last month's.

rows.text_zh: 外面雨好像停了，屋檐还在滴水。
rows.text_en: The rain outside seems to have stopped, but the eaves are still dripping.

rows.text_zh: 往北那条官道听说在修，不太好走。
rows.text_en: I hear the official road north is under repair—it's not easy to travel.

rows.text_zh: 这屋子住一晚要多少钱？
rows.text_en: How much does it cost to stay in this room for one night?

rows.text_zh: 已经这么晚了，你平时都什么时候歇？
rows.text_en: It's already so late—what time do you usually turn in?
